# Psychology Tools

> > Evidence-based therapy resources and clinical tools for mental health professionals treating a wide range of psychological conditions.

Psychology Tools is a comprehensive platform providing therapists, counselors, and mental health professionals with evidence-based treatment resources, worksheets, and psychoeducation materials. The site specializes in CBT, ACT, and other therapeutic approaches across conditions including anxiety, depression, eating disorders, and trauma.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
- CBT for Eating Disorders (CBT-ED)
- Evidence-Based Treatment
- Clinical Worksheets
- Psychoeducation Materials
- Anxiety Disorders
- Depression
- Eating Disorders
- Trauma & PTSD
- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- EMDR
- Professional Clinical Tools
- Therapy Resources
- Mental Health Interventions

## Mood & Emotion Disorders

- [Depression](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/depression): Depression treatment resources including CBT, ACT, and understanding guides.
- [Anxiety](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/anxiety): Anxiety disorder worksheets for GAD, panic, health anxiety, and social anxiety.
- [Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD)](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/generalized-anxiety-disorder-gad): GAD-specific resources with fight-or-flight and catastrophizing handouts.
- [Bipolar Disorder](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/bipolar-disorder): Bipolar disorder therapeutic resources including Unified Protocol guides.
- [Anger](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/anger): Anger management frameworks and CBT techniques for clinical practice.
- [Grief & Loss](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/grief-loss-bereavement): Grief and bereavement therapeutic resources including death anxiety guides.

## Eating Disorders & Body Image

- [Eating Disorders](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/eating-disorders): Eating disorders overview with CBT models and comprehensive psychoeducation.
- [Anorexia Nervosa](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/anorexia): Anorexia nervosa resources including CBT-ED guides and psychoeducation materials.
- [Bulimia Nervosa](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/bulimia): Bulimia nervosa resources with CBT-ED treatment guides and psychoeducation.
- [Body Dysmorphic Disorder (BDD)](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/body-dysmorphic-disorder-bdd): Body dysmorphic disorder CBT resources and understanding guides.

## Anxiety & Health Conditions

- [Health Anxiety](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/health-anxiety): Health anxiety treatment resources with CBT guides for symptom misinterpretation.
- [Fatigue](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/fatigue): Fatigue and CFS/ME resources with stress response and burnout guides.
- [Audiology](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/audiology): Audiology resources for tinnitus and PPPD with CBT models and handouts.
- [Dissociation](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/dissociation): Dissociation resources with audio collections and self-monitoring records.

## Behavioral & Neurodevelopmental Conditions

- [Addiction](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/addiction): Addiction treatment resources including relapse prevention worksheets and audio therapy.
- [Body Focused Repetitive Behaviors](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/body-focused-repetitive-behaviors): Body-focused repetitive behaviors treatment with habit reversal and ACT approaches.
- [Autism](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/autism): Autism spectrum disorder resources with CBT adaptations and assessment tools.
- [Challenging Behavior](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/challenging-behavior): Challenging behavior support for learning disabilities and dementia care.

## Communication & Life Skills

- [Assertiveness](https://www.psychologytools.com/professional/problems/assertiveness): Assertiveness training handouts and communication skills exercises.

## Core Resources

- [Psychology Tools Homepage](https://www.psychologytools.com): Psychology Tools homepage: evidence-based therapy resources for mental health professionals.
